claim.statement: Static Variant alternatives reuse existing exact Count/Sum leaf codecs and wrapper-specific sparse row domains, roles and physical bindings. No serializer per recursive type product or widening of fixed legacy public unions is required.
claim.adversary_verdict: ROBUST within the seven-profile quiescent Wide/LZ4/Default/plain-mrk2 BASIC-discriminator scope; general recursive products and remaining state families/layouts are not qualified.

trust.F: Compiling descriptor admission RED/green, independent literal RowBinary/lane oracles, externally pinned helper artifacts, stock/native checks and coherent raw CHECK-zero/terminal-lane controls; not a formal proof.
trust.G: Seven measured quiescent Wide/LZ4/Default/plain-mrk2 BASIC-discriminator profiles, five parent rows and real marks [2,2,1] plus terminal zero; not all Cartesian products or physical layouts.
trust.R: Root executed all compiler/native/audit jobs and inspected delegated diffs, raw observations, pins and controls. Luna static review is same-lineage correlated evidence, not independent runtime replication.

boundaries.risk: CAUTION: persistent format/admission boundary; existing recursive codecs and public routes are reused.
boundaries.rollback: Revert the exact-path atomic local W225 commit; preserve unrelated changes. No push, amend or remote history rewrite.
accepted: Static Variant alternatives containing already-admitted Count or W223 Sum-family states through the shared contextual admission owner.
Normal/canonical/wire descriptors, generic scalar/bulk values, paired readers/writers, typed callback batches/windows and detached owned column .values.

Root Variant with Count/Sum/String in SingleStream and WithSizeStream; globally unused String or Sum arms and all-NULL marks; Array(Variant), Variant(Array(AFsum)) and Variant(Tuple(AFcount,AFsum)) in the finite native roster.
Count retains exact nominal VarUInt dispatch; Sum state remains opaque and argument descriptors remain metadata, not stored value lanes.
rejected_or_guard_only: Direct Nullable(AF), LowCardinality(AF), invalid direct Variant(Variant), Variant(Dynamic), Variant(Nullable), QBit restrictions and library AF Map-key guards are unchanged.
Object's delayed Variant constructor, Dynamic runtime/known/shared AF alternatives and JSON typed/runtime/shared AF contexts are not widened.
JSON AF type declaration acceptance is separate from the pinned runtime's extraction-tree serializer refusal.
not_claimed: All recursive Cartesian products, every AggregateFunction state family, Compact parts, COMPACT discriminators, sparse/custom serialization or mutable live parts.
Native whole-catalog/offline discovery or native projection integration; offline .values witnesses use synthetic library catalogs and selected projection-child tests are unit-level.

Native MV/projection writing or execution semantics, aggregate execution/finalization, PK whitelist expansion, broad facade decomposition, peak RSS, read performance or the <=10 percent read-gap goal.
The inherited fixed 64 MiB callback budget at its exact large-fixture boundary, full production payload-hash authentication or whole-repository test closure.

architecture.law: Compose leaf serde with wrapper-specific stream, row-domain, prefix/state and mark context. Recursive RowBinary concatenation alone does not certify MergeTree bulk layout.
changes: src/crystal_click/binary_aggregate_function_recursive_admission.cr traverses Variant alternatives like Tuple fields, with AF-free siblings neutral.
src/crystal_click/binary_data_type.cr normal and wire Variant gates use the same static contextual owner; canonical roster laws and the narrower Object constructor remain unchanged.
architecture.strongest_failure: Confusing parent rows/marks, array elements and sparse selected-arm rows, or routing every tag 0x25 to Count.
falsifiers: Globally unused arms and all-NULL marks retain full child mark grids.
Count UInt64 maximum uses VarUInt; Sum(UInt8)=256 occupies an eight-byte accumulator lane.
Wrong nominal/selected-arm corruption rejects before the first callback.
Owned String/array-cell exact-fit and one-short limits reject without retained-value aliasing.
Successful-exit CHECK=0 is rejected despite a green summary; exact restoration returns to positive audit.
A trailing literal byte past the terminal lane offset is rejected before destination publication.
architecture.limits: Static admission traversal is not a performance or independent constructor-cost bound. Physical declarations are budgeted; logical ownership accounting is not peak RSS.

source_reference.distinction: Shallow comparison source and runtime are separate pins; neither same-build correlation nor perpetual latest-master compatibility is asserted.

laws.law: Variant admits ordinary AggregateFunction alternatives and orders alternatives by complete type name.
Variant discriminator is UInt8; 255 is the NULL discriminator.
RowBinary Variant writes a global discriminator then delegates to the selected child serializer; null uses the special discriminator.
Substream names encode array levels, string-size streams, escaped tuple fields, Variant discriminator lanes, and escaped Variant arm paths.
Filename escaping passes isWordCharASCII bytes and renders every other byte as uppercase %HH.
MergeTree exposes use_compact_variant_discriminators_serialization; setting it to 0 selects BASIC discriminator serialization.
AggregateFunction RowBinary delegates state serialization/deserialization to the aggregate function.
LowCardinality constructor refuses AggregateFunction because it does not opt in.
JSON typed-path declarations are constructed independently; serialization later recursively obtains typed-path serializers and builds the JSON extraction tree.
defaultValueOfTypeName constructs the declared DataType through DataTypeFactory and returns its default value.
JSON DataTypeObject default is a default Object value; formatting that value is a separate serializer context.
JSON extraction tree dispatches supported types and rejects an unsupported typed-path type in its default case.
